title: Grievance & Casus Belli Intake Form
subtitle: “Omnis Questus, Nullus Sanguis” — All Profit, No Blood

style.head: split
style.motto: PROFIT ABOVE ALL · NEUTRAL BY POLICY ·

instructions: **Before you begin:** this form must be completed in full before any declaration of hostilities against the Consolidated Industrial Concern will be acknowledged, reviewed, tabled, or otherwise considered to exist. Incomplete submissions are not rejected — they are simply filed alongside complete ones, in the same drawer, in no particular order.

sections.title: Matter Reference

fields.text: **Matter:** unsolicited declaration of total war. **Received:** four (4) transmissions on frequency 0xUNKNOWN, one of them encoded, dated 2026-09-11. **Status:** filed under *Correspondence*. Not read.

fields.name: transmission_intent
fields.label: The transmissions received by the Concern were intended as (select all that apply):
options: A formal declaration of war
A warning
Not a warning, as the transmission itself states
A retraction
“Just kidding”
“…Or are we?”
A status update regarding assets the Concern has not reported missing

sections.note: Where more than one box is selected, each is treated as a separate transmission and requires its own Form GC-1.

fields.name: party_name
fields.label: Name of declaring party / organization
fields.placeholder: As it will appear in Ledger 7

fields.name: name_is_word
fields.label: Is the name given above a word meaning “not known”?
options: No
Yes
Yes, and we are aware of how that looks on a form

fields.name: closing_spelling
fields.label: Spelling of your faction name as it appears in the closing line of your encoded transmission
fields.help: The Concern’s decryption reads “Unkmown out.” If Unkmown is a separate entity, it must file its own Form GC-1.

fields.name: channel
fields.label: Preferred correspondence channel
fields.placeholder: Frequency, relay, or carrier pigeon designation. A valid hexadecimal value is preferred.

fields.name: not_at_war
fields.label: I attest that I am not currently at war with the CIC as of the date of this filing.
fields.help: If checked in error, see Form GC-1b, “Retroactive Peace.”

sections.title: Casus Belli Classification

fields.name: casus_belli
options: Grid or cargo theft
Territorial dispute
Aesthetic grievance (paint scheme, ship silhouette, or station lighting)
Vibes
Conduct of a former member while wearing the Concern’s tag
Readmission of that former member to the Concern
Perceived hypocrisy regarding the Concern’s stated pacifism
Unspecified / classified — grounds to be disclosed only to a notary who is currently on sabbatical
Other — attach Form GC-4, “Explain Yourself”

sections.note: Select all that apply. Selecting none is treated as selecting all, per Subsection 12(c)(iv)(iv).

sections.title: Statement of Grievance

fields.name: statement
fields.label: Describe the grievance in no fewer than 500 words. Testimony is preferred in the third person.
fields.placeholder: Begin with: “On the date in question, the aggrieved party…”

fields.name: attributed_individual
fields.label: Name of the individual whose conduct is attributed to the Concern

fields.name: membership_dates
fields.label: Dates on which that individual was, was not, and was again a member

sections.note: Statements under 500 words will not be rejected, but will be quietly assumed to be Section 5 material and re-filed accordingly.

fields.name: asset
fields.label: Designation and registry number of the CIC asset alleged to have been removed
fields.placeholder: “The heart of your industrial operations” is not a registry number

fields.name: photo_attached
fields.label: A photograph of the remains is attached.
fields.help: Photographs must be notarized, in triplicate, by someone other than the notary listed in Section 7.

fields.name: coordinates
fields.label: I confirm that I hold coordinates for a CIC facility and that I will not be writing them on this form.
fields.help: The Concern holds yours, and extends the same courtesy.

fields.name: attachments
options: Proof of Standing (Form GC-2)
Certificate of Grievance Severity (Form GC-3, which itself requires Form GC-3a)
Notarized copy of this form, in triplicate, notarized by someone other than the notary listed in Section 7
Declaration of Non-Duplicative Grievance, swearing this filing is not a duplicate of any Form GC-1 already on file, including this one
Waiver of Further Warnings (Form GC-6), since your transmission states that none will be issued, and this form is one

fields.name: notary
fields.label: Notary public signature
fields.placeholder: Currently on sabbatical — see Form GC-9 to request alternate notarization

fields.name: negotiation
fields.label: I acknowledge that completing this form constitutes correspondence with the Concern, and that correspondence is a form of negotiation.

finePrint: By filing, the declaring party acknowledges that this form does not constitute acceptance, rejection, or acknowledgment of any grievance, hostility, or correspondence, and may generate further forms.
transmittal: **Transmittal:** send this copy to the Consolidated Industrial Concern by the channel through which your declaration was made. Retain a duplicate. The Concern will retain the original, and will not read it.

receipt.message: Your copy of **{{code}}** has been saved as **{{file}}**. Transmit it to the Concern. Before this matter can proceed, please complete **Form {{next}}** (attached).
footnotes: Note: Form {{next}} supersedes Form {{code}} but does not invalidate it. Both remain on file, indefinitely, in the same drawer.
